name: AgentSafe / SAFE
summary: Evaluates agents on adversarial hazardous instructions in the SAFE-THOR environment, with separate scores for perception, planning and execution.
numbers: 45 scenarios, 1,350 tasks, 9,900 instructions; agents recognise hazards but still act

why.dex: Abstract primitives via a universal adapter.
why.cog: Adversarial phrasing; must turn recognition into refusal.
why.xr: Risks to humans, environment and the agent; deliberate harm included.
